messages:
jane_cs: Heads up — Papertrail (PO 12345) reported ~120 batch invoice autopays yesterday; ~18 failed. They see two patterns: `insufficient_funds` and `3DS_CHALLENGE_FAILED`. Ticket 9876 opened with logs attached.

alex_support: Can you drop a couple of charge IDs and a sample request/response? Also which region/connector?

jane_cs: Charge ids: ch_248a1, ch_248b2, ch_248c3. Region: us-west1, connector: bright-gate-prod. Sample webhook snippet:
```json
{"id":"ch_248a1","status":"failed","failure_code":"insufficient_funds","issuer_code":"51"}
```

maria_eng: Looking at service logs — we saw a spike of 502/504 from the connector between 20:02-20:10 UTC and a series of 429s from the acquirer at ~20:05. Also ACS returned `403 challenge not allowed` for a subset of flows.

sam_oncall: Are these retries hitting our rate limiter? @payments_infra_bot, can you show recent outbound rate-limit alerts?

payments_infra_bot: ALERT: connector-bright-gate egress rate-limit -> 429 returned by acquirer (2026-03-15T20:04:51Z - 2026-03-15T20:08:12Z). Avg rps 180, configured limit 150. Backoff policy applied.

maria_eng: That matches — clients retried aggressively, and delayed responses caused some 3DS sessions to expire -> `3DS_CHALLENGE_FAILED`. For the `insufficient_funds` ones, issuer decline code `51` present on the trace.

alex_support: So two buckets: issuer-side NSF (code 51) and acquirer rate limiting causing delayed auths -> expired 3DS sessions. Action items: collect full request/response for one 3DS failed charge and one NSF charge.

jane_cs: Attached full traces in ticket: trace_abc (3DS failure) and trace_def (NSF). Customer also says their retry policy is immediate x3. They want a recommended playbook.

fraud_ops: quick check — no elevated risk scores for Papertrail. No fraud rule hits.

maria_eng: Proposed mitigation:
1) Advise client to use exponential backoff for retries (e.g., 1s -> 3s -> 9s) instead of immediate retries.
2) Temporarily reduce batch concurrency for bright-gate for this merchant.
3) Open a request with the acquirer to increase concurrency quota.

sam_oncall: I'll push a canary config to reduce concurrency to 5 for Papertrail and monitor. If 3DS failures drop, we can apply per-merchant throttle.

alex_support: For the customer note: NSF responses (issuer code 51) mean insufficient funds — recommend they contact the payer's bank and retry once after customer confirmation. For the 3DS failures, explain we are throttling their batch to avoid ACS session expiry and will ask the acquirer for quota bump.

jane_cs: Customer ok with temporary throttle. Please tag when done.

payments_infra_bot: ACTION: started canary throttle for merchant Papertrail (config-id: throttle-pp-248). Monitoring hooks created: `throttle-pp-248` -> metrics stream attached.

maria_eng: Follow-up: after throttle deployment, 429s from acquirer dropped 93% within 10m and `3DS_CHALLENGE_FAILED` events dropped from 7 -> 1 in the sampled window. We'll schedule acquirer contact for a quota request.

alex_support: Thanks team. Closing loop: update ticket 9876 with the playbook steps, include traces, and note we will keep throttle for 24h then reassess. :thumbsup:

sam_oncall: monitoring alert set for 24h. If any regression we rollback the throttle and open incident.

jane_cs: Noted — I'll update the customer and close once they confirm successful retries.
